post.description:
Search the web, news, or images and get structured results with ads and HTML noise removed, as JSON, Markdown, or HTML.

Choose a mode:
- **Standard search** — web, news, or image results, with optional time, category, domain, city, and device filters.
- **Search with scrape** — set `scrape: true` to include the full content of the top result pages.
- **Grounded answer** — set `groundedAnswer: true` for an AI-synthesized answer with citations.
- **SERP** — set `serp: true` for the full Google results page (organic results, ads, related searches, People Also Ask).

source.description: Search source. SERP mode accepts one source per request.

category.description: Category filter. Ignored in SERP mode.

format.description: Output format. Ignored in SERP mode.

scrape.description: scrape and extract content from SERP result URLs. Ignored in SERP mode.

scrapeLimit.description: Number of URLs to scrape (requires scrape: true). Ignored in SERP mode.

groundedAnswer.description: Use AI to synthesize a grounded answer from search results. Ignored in SERP mode.

serp.description: Return the full Google search results page (SERP) including organic results, AI Overviews, related searches, People Also Ask, pagination, and more. Supported in this mode: `query`, `location`, `city`, `device`, `limit`, `source` (one value), `time`, `includeDomains`, and `excludeDomains`. It returns the first page of results.

city.description: City to target for localized results, using the name exactly as listed in the supported cities file, e.g. `London,England,United Kingdom`. Works with standard search and with `serp: true`. When set, it takes priority over `location`. Supported cities: https://cdn.geekflare.com/api-assets/geotargets-2026-08-12.json

refresh.description: Force on-demand fetch and refresh the cache, bypassing any existing cached data

mode.description: Depth of brand data to return. Enriched includes LLM-synthesized company intelligence.

cached.description: Whether this response was served from cache

lastUpdated.description: When the underlying data was last fetched/updated

dataAge.description: Human-readable age of the cached data

refreshRequested.description: Whether a forced refresh was requested

baseUnit.description: Heuristic: mode of observed small padding/margin values, not a guaranteed design token

BrandCompanyDto.description: LLM-synthesized company intelligence. Only present when mode is `enriched`. Coverage depends on public information available for the domain — not every field is populated for every site.

industry.description: Primary industry or category the company operates in

stockTicker.description: Stock ticker symbol, present when kind is PUBLICLY_TRADED

BrandPageMetaDto.description: Meta tags scraped from the page head. Which tags are present depends on what the site itself publishes — not every site sets every Open Graph or Twitter Card tag.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the request in milliseconds
Timestamp of the request in milliseconds

status.description: Health status of the service (e.g., healthy, degraded, down)

message.description: Additional info or error message if any

message.description: Top-level message summarizing the overall health check
